text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower came along with Sakura 
Bakushin O to watch the Tenno Sho 
(Spring).

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There, she witnesses the heroic figure of 
Mejiro McQueen captivating the spectators 
on the grand stage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Watching Mejiro McQueen bring smiles and 
happiness to so many people, Rice Shower 
likens her to a "blue rose."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower, believing she only brings 
misfortune to everyone, shares her dream 
of wanting to become just like that "blue 
rose."
